scientific_integrity: The finite combinatorial formulas have exact symbolic and exhaustive finite checks. The infinite-dimensional bound is established analytically by a published Chen-Stein process theorem; independent external verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent fair edge orientations only, induced-facet sinks, one pair of facets; no conditioning on acyclicity. The total-variation constant is not asserted optimal. Priority qualification: general local-dependence Poisson approximation is classical and an exhaustive historical review has not been performed.
title: A sharp dimension-four dependence onset and common-shock Poisson law for sinks of adjacent cube facets
